arts.title: FIREBALL
arts.desc: Gather a fireball at the belly and throw it. Sets the target alight and knocks him flat.
arts.evo_desc: A burning bird: pierces the whole line and leaves fire on the street.

arts.title: LIGHTNING DASH
arts.desc: Blink forward as a bolt, through everyone in the way. Stuns what you pass.
arts.evo_desc: The bolt jumps on to three more thugs after the dash.

arts.title: WIND KICK
arts.desc: A spinning kick that throws a whirlwind. Launches everyone close.
arts.evo_desc: The whirlwind stays, drags them in and juggles them.

arts.title: ICE SLIDE
arts.desc: A low slide on a sheet of ice. Freezes legs solid for a few seconds.
arts.evo_desc: Frozen thugs shatter in an ice burst that freezes the next ones.

arts.title: FIRE PALM
arts.desc: Charge both hands at the gut, then a palm strike that blows out a cone of fire.
arts.evo_desc: A dragon's head of flame that sends the whole crowd flying.

arts.title: THUNDER CLAP
arts.desc: One clap, one shockwave down the street. Stuns everything it rolls over.
arts.evo_desc: Three waves, each one bigger. Lightning finishes the stunned.

arts.title: MAGMA UPPERCUT
arts.desc: An uppercut out of a pillar of lava. Launches and burns.
arts.evo_desc: The street erupts in three pillars around you.

arts.title: EARTHQUAKE STOMP
arts.desc: Stomp the asphalt. A ring of cracking stone knocks everyone down.
arts.evo_desc: Stone spikes come up under every thug on the ground.

grabs.title: MONKEY FLIP
grabs.desc: Feet on his chest, roll back, throw him over you.

grabs.title: TORNADO DDT
grabs.desc: Run up the thug, spin around his neck, plant his head in the street.

grabs.title: FRANKENSTEINER
grabs.desc: Thighs on his head, backflip, he goes head first behind you.

grabs.title: GIANT SWING
grabs.desc: Grab the ankles, spin three times, let go into the crowd.

grabs.title: GERMAN SUPLEX
grabs.desc: Arms round the waist, bridge, back of the head into the asphalt.

grabs.title: HEADLOCK KNEES
grabs.desc: Headlock, three knees to the face, shove him away.

team.title: DADDY LAUNCH
team.desc: Dad cups his hands, the kid flies off them feet first through the crowd.

team.title: TAG TEAM SLAM
team.desc: The kid sweeps him up, Dad catches and powerbombs him.

team.title: FAMILY DOUBLE
team.desc: Both heroes, both fireballs at once: one huge blast.
